newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bristol upgraded by Merrill.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bristol upgraded by Merrill.

text.p: Merrill Lynch pharmaceuticals industry analyst Steve Tighe said he upgraded Bristol-Myers Squibb Co to long-term buy from long-term accumulate.
Shares in the drug manufacturer were up 7-1/2 to 83-7/8.
Tighe said he made the move based on the issuance to Bristol on Tuesday of a use patent covering infusion of Taxol, a drug for treating metastatic breast and ovarian cancer.
Taxol faces potential generic competition, but Tighe said the patent may extend Bristol's exclusivity with the drug.
